notes: Reviewed official catalogs, pricing and API compatibility for the omnibar Weather release. No model, adapter or pricing implementation changes are required. The changed Google pricing page removed context-caching rows for Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS across Standard, Batch, Flex and Priority; Browser does not select those speech models. Text Gemini 3.8 Flash Standard input/output/cache remain $0.75/$3.75/$0.075 per million through 2026, rising to $1.50/$7.50/$0.15 on January 1, 2027. Gemini pricing remains explicit per-selected-model configuration or unknown. Custom endpoints, installed local models, pinned dated snapshots, model roles and provider boundaries remain intact. Future runs price and record their actual selected model; historical runs are unchanged. Weather uses native Apple WeatherKit with explicit city or previously authorized location and adds no AI-provider calls. No credentials or billable inference used.
